description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultShapeTableManager class, which manages shape tables with caching, building, and dependency resolution for the OrchardCore display management system.

classes.name: DefaultShapeTableManager
classes.description: Manages shape tables with caching and dynamic building based on tenant and theme, supporting concurrency and dependency resolution.

methods.name: GetShapeTableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the shape table for a given theme, using cache if available.

methods.name: GetShapeTableInternalAsync
methods.description: Builds the shape table internally with locking to prevent concurrent rebuilds.

methods.name: BuildShapeTableAsync
methods.description: Constructs the shape table by discovering shape alterations, filtering features, and creating descriptors.

methods.name: BuildDescriptors
methods.description: Creates shape descriptors from alterations grouped by feature and shape type.

methods.name: IsModuleOrRequestedTheme
methods.description: Determines if a feature is a module or matches the requested theme, considering dependencies.
